verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents programmatic creation of connected accounts for businesses and individuals, which covers seller onboarding. It also documents Transfers for paying out funds to third parties. However, nothing shows splitting a single payment between platform and sellers, and the sandbox explicitly excludes Connected Account APIs, which limits testing of the platform flow. Missing for 10: documented payment splitting or platform-fee routing, payouts tied specifically to connected accounts, sandbox support for Connected Account APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a working marketplace build.
